WHO WE ARE

A local team of renewable energy professionals, engineered to last.

Impact Energy Solution is a Lilongwe-based renewable energy company delivering solar, water pumping and clean cooking systems for homes, institutions and farms across Malawi. We size every system to the site, not a catalogue.

Our project: the Dowa Mpisi solar water pumping system with drip irrigation for farming.

Our location: Lilongwe Area 23 and Area 49, Malawi.

Contact: Steve Khomba, Co-founder and Director of Marketing and Business Development — +265 881 682 589.

A local company registered with the Registrar of Companies and licensed by the Malawi Energy Regulatory Authority (MERA).

Feb 2023 Working across the Lilongwe Area and beyond since our first installs
OUR VISION

To become a leading provider of inclusive clean energy solutions that transform livelihoods and protect the environment in Malawi and across the region.

OUR MISSION

To deliver accessible, affordable and sustainable energy technologies through innovative distribution systems, strong community partnerships and digital tools that ensure efficient last-mile delivery and long-term customer satisfaction.

OUR SERVICES

Design, installation and maintenance, all from one team.

We handle standalone and hybrid solar systems, solar water pumping for homes, institutions and farms, mini-grids, and clean cooking — quoted after a site visit, then maintained for as long as you run the system.

01

Standalone & hybrid solar systems

Panels, charge controller, inverter and battery bank sized for a home, shop or clinic — fully off-grid or hybrid with backup during outages.

→
02

Solar water pumping

Borehole and tank-tower pumping for homes, institutions and farms, including drip-irrigation setups like our Dowa Mpisi project.

→
03

Mini-grids

Shared generation and distribution built for a cluster of homes, a village centre or a small estate.

→
04

Clean cooking technologies

Efficient stoves and fuel alternatives that cut smoke and firewood use in the kitchen.

→
05

Biogas installation

Digesters that turn farm and kitchen waste into cooking gas for homes and small institutions.

→
06

Maintenance & servicing

Scheduled inspection, troubleshooting and repair to keep every system performing well after handover.

HOW A PROJECT RUNS

From first call to a system that's yours to run.

Step 1

Site visit & survey

We check your roof, borehole or field, your power draw, and what the budget allows.

Step 2

System design & quote

Panel count, battery bank and pipe runs specified in writing before any deposit.

Step 3

Installation

Mounting, wiring, plumbing and brickwork handled by our own crew, not a subcontractor.

Step 4

Handover & support

We walk you through the system and stay reachable for servicing after the install.

WHY CHOOSE IMPACT ENERGY SOLUTION

Practical, reliable and sustainable energy solutions tailored to your needs.

Sized to the site, not the shelf

Every quote follows a real site visit — no fixed packages that leave you short of power or paying for capacity you don't need.

Integrated Installation from Start to Finish

Our technical team coordinates electrical, plumbing and structural works throughout the installation process, ensuring smooth project delivery, consistent quality and clear accountability from start to finish.

Built for irrigation and off-grid life

From borehole pumps to mini-grids, we design for the way power and water are actually used here.

Continued Support After Installation

Our support does not end at handover. We provide ongoing servicing and troubleshooting to help keep your system operating reliably, with our technical team available to respond to your support needs.
